title: 雪 (Yuki — Snow)
description: A beloved winter children's song from the 1911 Ministry of Education songbook. Snow and sleet pile up on mountains and fields, turning bare trees into blooming flowers. The second verse captures two classic images every Japanese child knows: a dog running happily in the yard and a cat curled up snug by the kotatsu heated table.
